annotations.title: Find golf rounds and golf trips

description: Use this when the user wants to play golf in Japan with the round and transport arranged: a round at a named course near Tokyo, Mt Fuji, Hakone or Kansai (Kyoto, Osaka, Shiga), a one-day golf trip with hotel pickup from Tokyo, or a multi-day golf package (Tokyo, Hakone, Mt Fuji, Kyoto, Hokkaido, Okinawa). Returns each course or package with its area, the per-golfer price where OlaChill publishes one (golf only, or golf with a private transfer), optional add-ons, the club's own cancellation terms, and whether it can be paid online or is handled on request. Read-only. Do not use it for golf equipment shopping or driving ranges, for a car with driver without golf (use search_chauffeur_services), or for sightseeing tours and activities (use search_travel_products).

days.description: Trip length in days. 1 = a single round or one-day trip; 2 or more puts multi-day packages first.

golfers.description: Number of golfers. Used to show the total for each priced package (per-golfer price times golfers).

locale.description: Language for product names and page links (en, ja, ko, zh = Simplified Chinese, tw = Traditional Chinese, es, fr, de, it, th, id, vi). Default en.

region.description: tokyo = Tokyo and around; fuji = Mt Fuji, Gotemba and Hakone; kansai = Kyoto, Osaka and Shiga; hokkaido and okinawa = multi-day packages only. Omit to list every area.

name: search_golf_packages

error.description: Present only when the call failed; a short reason the user can act on.

price.description: Price in the stated currency; null when no reliable price is published.

unit.description: What the price covers, e.g. per_person, per_vehicle_per_day, per_vehicle_hours, per_esim, per_month.

area.description: Area in Japan the service covers, or null when it applies nationwide.

booking_method.description: online_checkout = pay on the page; online_request = submit the form, OlaChill confirms by email before any payment; quote_request = send the details and OlaChill replies with a price.

booking_status.description: bookable_online = a fixed price can be paid on the page when booking; on_request = OlaChill checks first and nothing is charged when the request is sent.

id.description: Stable OlaChill id for this course, package, vehicle option or plan.

options.description: Packages at this course, each priced per golfer.

price.description: Price in the stated currency; null when no reliable price is published.

unit.description: What the price covers, e.g. per_person, per_vehicle_per_day, per_vehicle_hours, per_esim, per_month.

total_for_golfers.description: Price in the stated currency; null when no reliable price is published.

unit.description: What the price covers, e.g. per_person, per_vehicle_per_day, per_vehicle_hours, per_esim, per_month.

pickup.description: Pickup or meeting area and driving time to the course.

price.description: Price in the stated currency; null when no reliable price is published.

unit.description: What the price covers, e.g. per_person, per_vehicle_per_day, per_vehicle_hours, per_esim, per_month.

price_basis.description: What the price covers and how firm it is (fixed, from, class-tier estimate, reference or no published price).

service_type.description: golf_course_day = one round at one course with optional transfer; golf_package = one-day or multi-day itinerary arranged on request.

trip_length.description: Golf packages only: one-day, multi-day or both.

url.description: Page on olachill.com where the traveller books or sends the request.

weekday_only.description: True when OlaChill sells this course on weekdays only.

title: Find golf rounds and golf trips
